profile.headline: Software Developer at Milyli Inc
profile.summary: I am someone who wants to make something that brings a smile to everyone's face, something that people will have fun with, and something that will create great memories for the people playing it.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: As a Software Engineer at Robomodo, I program mostly in C# on mobile game titles with Unity.  I've also had recent experience with Objective-C, Unix shell scripting, Hudson build pipeline, Testflight, and more.

positions.title: QA Tester
positions.description: Do rigourous testing on a video game and report any bugs.  Gained experience with Github and Jira issue tracking software.

positions.title: Junior Software Engineer
positions.description:
As a Junior Software Engineer at Robomodo, I worked on the leaderboards and achievements/trophies system for Tony Hawk's Pro Skater HD.  I also helped with various other tasks to make our front-end TRC/TCR compliant.  

Here I gained experience with Unreal Engine 3, as well as Flash ActionScript 2.0, as well as my first opportunity to work in a large existing code-base.

positions.title: Customer Service Specialist
positions.description: Help customers find what they need, check them out on the register, stock shelves, and help keep the store looking nice and organized.

positions.title: Game Lab Moderator
positions.description: Watch over the game labs, enforce lab policies, check in/out games for people, recommend games.

positions.title: Multimedia Producer
positions.description: Captured media footage of InSTEP summer activities and edited them together for other teachers to view.  Updated content on the website.  Data-entry with student surveys.

positions.title: Sandwich Associate
positions.description: Take sandwich/meal orders at a speedy rate, assemble sandwiches in a fast paced environment, work register, wash dishes, maintain cleanliness of the dining area.

positions.title: Park Services Host
positions.description: Kept an area of the park clean, helped attendees with directions and other questions.

projects.title: Operation: Snowfall
projects.description:
A crazy 2.5D side-scrolling secret agent snowboarding game for mobile.

Areas I was responsible for:
- Hudson/Jenkins build machine setup and support
- Various internal systems such as save data, in-app purchasing, analytics, gadget crafting, local push notifications, leaderboards/achievement support.

projects.title: Tony Hawk's Pro Skater 5
projects.description:
Areas I was responsible for:
- Hudson/Jenkins build machine setup and support
- Tasked as build engineer to make builds that could run on Xbox One and PlayStation 4 from our project base in Unreal Engine 3
- Created build scripts using Python to work in conjunction with Hudson/Jenkins in order to automate builds in a timely fashion for testing and build submission nights
- Worked with Audio to integrate the Wwise engine into our Unreal Engine 3 project
- Integrated cooking and updating audio changes from Wwise project into Python build script auto-submit pipeline
- Added support for changing and attaching new head/body/board pieces for Create-a-Skater
- Dividing game into chunks for initial launch on PlayStation 4 and Xbox One
- Integrated Xbox One events, and achievement support on both Xbox One and PlayStation 4
- Modified build scripts to support SDK updates, dedicated server output, and multi-region support (SCEE/SCEA)
- Uploading and deploying dedicated servers for new builds.  Required coordination between various groups (Internal QA, External QA, CERT/LIVE teams)
- Packaged, deployed, and tested DLC packs
